Local SEO for retail stores

Win the walk-ins your block is handing to the shop around the corner — see every street where a shopper finds a rival first.

Start with 10 free scans

Win the walk-ins, don’t lose them next door

Every “shoe store near me” or “gift shop open now” that finds a competitor first is a sale that walked past your door. A one-number rank tool can’t tell you where that’s happening — retail is won block by block, and the map pack reorders with every corner a shopper stands on. Eagle Eye shows the exact streets where the store wins foot traffic and the ones handing it to the shop around the corner, on both Google and Apple Maps — the surface iPhone shoppers use and most stores never check.

Beat a generic rank checker

  • Rank on every block, not one number — a tight grid from a 0.1-mile radius, so you see each street a shopper actually searches from.
  • LSOV — the share of the surrounding blocks that put the store in the top 3, one figure to grow.
  • A competitor map for every rival — exactly which shops are catching the “near me” searches you’re missing.
  • Both maps, one price — Google and Apple, so you win the shoppers a Google-only tool never sees.

Start free: a new account gets 10 free scans, and your first scan of your own store is free up to 21 × 21 — no card, and credits you buy never expire. See what scanning costs or track the iPhone side on Apple Maps.
